result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the bottom navigation bar shows clear visual defects: a stray thick black horizontal line overlays/replaces two of the nav icons, and the navigation bar itself appears vertically clipped so the icons are cut off at the bottom edge. Everything else (header, search, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards) renders correctly.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal line stretches across the middle of the bottom navigation bar, running through the search icon and the orders/receipt icon. It looks like a rendering artifact or a misplaced divider/scrollbar element rather than an intended design.
issues.suggestion: Inspect the bottom tab bar component and remove or correctly position the stray line element (e.g., a misconfigured active-tab indicator, divider, or overflow scrollbar); icons should render cleanly without overlapping strokes.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is vertically clipped: the home, search, orders, and profile icons are cut off at the bottom of the screen and any labels are not visible. A fixed navigation bar should always be fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the tab bar to the bottom safe area with correct height/padding (accounting for device insets) so all icons and labels are fully displayed.

issues.description: The two bottom-nav icons on the right (orders and profile) appear noticeably lighter/faded compared to the home icon, and there is no clear active-state indication beyond color, which is subtle.
issues.suggestion: Ensure inactive icons meet contrast guidelines and consider adding labels or a stronger active-state indicator so the current tab is unambiguous.
